choice_prompt:8:1820209006.text: I'm afraid not... This board was created exclusively for Senea by an artist commissioned by Lady Tephesia. There are only a handful, so they're not for sale.
choice_prompt:8:1820209006.source_cn: 啊……这个签名板是领主阁下请艺术家专门为塞涅小姐设计并绘制的，数量有限，不对外售卖。真不好意思。

say:9:1820209007:2.text: Yes. Her Ladyship's passionate about the arts, especially opera. The moment Senea arrived in Novaris, she immediately sent people to assist her.
say:9:1820209007:2.source_cn: 是的。领主阁下的艺术造诣非常高，她最喜欢的就是观看各种...

say:10:1820209008:1.text: From what I hear, Senea often gets invited to Her Ladyship's manor to offer her insights on theatrical productions!
say:10:1820209008:1.source_cn: 悄悄告诉你们……据我所知，塞涅小姐时不时还会受邀前往领...

choice_prompt:11:1820209008.text: From what I hear, Senea often gets invited to Her Ladyship's manor to offer her insights on theatrical productions!
choice_prompt:11:1820209008.source_cn: 悄悄告诉你们……据我所知，塞涅小姐时不时还会受邀前往领主阁下的庄园，和她分享戏剧编排上的心得呢……！

say:12:1820209009:1.text: I have no idea myself. Only invited guests are allowed to visit the manor.
say:12:1820209009:1.source_cn: 这我就不太清楚了。除非受邀，否则很少有亡灵能前往那里。

say:13:1820209010:1.text: Her Ladyship is a person of great stature, and she prefers keeping to herself...
say:13:1820209010:1.source_cn: 领主毕竟是领主，她其实很讨厌被人打搅……

say:15:1820209012:1.text: Sorry, I think my colleague's looking for me. I'll be back in a moment.
say:15:1820209012:1.source_cn: 啊，不好意思。我的同事在找我，我要先离开一下。

say:16:1820209013:1.text: While I'm away, feel free to check out the other booths! Lots of them are handing out freebies!
say:16:1820209013:1.source_cn: 请大家先去其他摊位参加活动吧！有不少摊位都会发放纪念品哦~
